dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Hehe... Just wait till she sees me in action!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'm Cipitz! The future mightiest wrestler in the Collective of Plenty — which means I'm plenty strong already, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Do you see that Tatankasaurus over there? It just tried to knock me down, but I grabbed its leg and executed a perfect take-down!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: I—I'm not joking! I really did that! Just you wait till I'm older — I'm going to wrestle a dragon, just like Wanjiru did! None of the taller warriors around here will be a match for me then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you taking part in training?

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Training? Hmph, that's so boring! It's just lifting weights and running laps, what's the point in practicing all that!?

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: A true warrior relies on their own power and skill to achieve victory! Watch, I can take on a Tatankasaurus... Well, a baby Tatankasaurus, which is more than that lot can manage with their running in circles!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: A—And another thing... Nappa's never undergone training either. What if she ran into trouble out here? As the future strongest warrior, it's my duty to protect her!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Alright, seeya! The next time you see me, I'll be even stronger!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: I lost! Darn it! Just you wait, I'll come back even stronger!
